## Description

Model a spread as a mean-reverting stochastic process and derive entry/exit thresholds from estimated parameters.

## Where it may fit

Spreads with measurable, persistent mean reversion and low structural-break risk.

## Vehicles

Pairs, futures calendar/intercommodity spreads, ETF relative-value funds.

## Required data

Synchronized spread time series, mean-reversion speed, long-run mean, volatility, financing/roll costs.

## Caveats

The model assumes mean-reverting dynamics; thresholds are fragile when parameters are unstable.
